code:
echo "Deploying with token $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"   # NEVER - prints the secret verbatim
set -x                                               # DANGEROUS in a script that touches secrets:
                                                     #    it echoes every command with its expanded values
description: The two lines that defeat the log mask and print a secret into a world-readable log.

steps.description: These two lines defeat the log mask and leak the token. A registered secret is masked as `***` in logs unless you print it yourself.
The first line prints the secret verbatim, so the mask never applies.
`set -x` echoes every command with its expanded values, so the token appears again in the log. The comment marks both as never and dangerous.

title: Two Lines That Leak the Token
